falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower highs and a multi-week consolidation; blowoff score of 40 suggests vulnerability to reversal, not breakout

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom pattern, which typically features elevated volatility that gradually normalizes but remains sticky; this would signal the 'unknown' verdict was masking a continuation rally, not a bottoming process

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ days while SPX simultaneously falls more than 2%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This stagflationary divergence would invalidate the bottom pattern, which requires rates and equities to move inversely (rates down = stocks up) during recovery; concurrent safe-haven bid in bonds with risk-off in stocks signals macro breakdown, not bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
